p000.setup: Stand with your feet very wide apart and toes outwards. Squat down with arms extended to hold the bar with a shoulder width grip, one overhand and one underhand.
p000.howto:
1.Exhale and squeeze your glutes and tighten your lats to lift the barbell until standing up straight.  2. Rotate your shoulders back until feeling slightly stretched.
3. Pause for a few seconds, inhale and return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p000.tips:
1. Position your hips between the level of shoulders and knees at the starting position.
2. Move the bar vertically.
3. Brace the abs to support your straight back throughout the movement.
4. Do not pull upward using your arms or shoulders.
5. Do not thrust your hips forward at the top position.

p001.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Hold the barbell across your back shoulders with hands slightly wider than shoulder width and palms facing forward.
p001.howto:
1. Rotate your torso to one side while keeping your lower body still.
2. Pause for a few seconds and return to the starting position slowly.
3. Complete alternating between left and right.
p001.tips: 1.Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p002.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Place the bar on the back of your shoulders and bend arms to hold it with palms facing forward.
p002.howto:
1. Bend at your waist and squeeze obliques to one side as far as possible.
2. Hold for a few seconds, return to the starting position and repeat.
3.  Switch to the other side and repeat the same repetitions.
p002.tips:
1. Keep your head up throughout the movement.
2.Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p003.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Place the bar on the back of your shoulders and bend arms to hold it with palms facing forward.
p003.howto:
1. Bend at your waist and squeeze obliques to one side as far as possible.
2. Hold for a few seconds, return to the starting position and repeat.
3. Switch to the other side and repeat the same repetitions.
p003.tips:
1. Keep your head up throughout the movement.
2.Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p004.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Bend at the waist with your back and legs straight and hold a barbell in an overhand grip.
p004.howto:
1. Exhale and squeeze your glutes and tighten your lats to lift the barbell until standing up straight.
2. Pause for a few seconds, inhale and return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p004.tips:
1. Move the bar vertically.
2. Brace the abs to support your straight back throughout the movement.
3. Keep your legs straight but do not lock your knees.
4. Do not pull upward using your arms or shoulders.
5. Do not thrust your hips forward at the top position.

p005.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Hold the barbell in an overhand grip at shoulder width in front of your hips with arms extended.
p005.howto:
1. Raise your elbows up and out to the sides until the bar is at your chin level.
2. Contract your shoulders and hold for a few seconds.
3. Lower the bar to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p005.tips:
1. Keep your hands moving vertically.
2. Keep your elbows higher than your forearms during the exercise.
3. Keep the bar close to your body.
4. Keep a straight back during the exercise.

p006.setup: Put your feet under the bar. Bend down and crouch to grip the bar with a wider than shoulder width, overhand grip.
p006.howto:
1. Drive your hips up and straighten your legs to pull the barbell up.
2.  Once the bar passes your mid-thigh, jump slightly.
3.  Accelerate the bar upward towards your chest.
4. Quickly move the bar down to your thighs with your body totally upright.
5. Slowly return the bar to the starting point and repeat.
p006.tips:
1. Do not pull the bar using your arms.
2. To add difficulty, add weights gradually.
3. Keep your knees and elbows slightly bent during the exercise.
4. Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p007.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Hold a barbell on your shoulders behind you with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width apart.
p007.howto:
1. Descend your body to a squat position while extending your arms to press the barbell over your head.
2. Brace you core and drive through your feet to stand up straight.
3. Lower the barbell to the starting position and repeat.
p007.tips:
1.Do not flare your elbows out.
2. Do not let your knees go over your toes when you squat.
3. To add difficulty, add weights gradually.
4. Keep your knees and elbows slightly bent during the exercise.
5. Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p008.setup: Put your feet under the bar. Bend down to grip the bar with a wider than shoulder width and in an overhand grip.
p008.howto:
1. Drive your hips up and straighten your legs to pull the barbell up.
2. Once the bar passes your mid-thigh, jump slightly and drop your body under the bar while lifting the barbell overhead with palms facing forward.
3.  As you lift the barbell, lower your hips to a front squat position.
4.  Brace you core and drive through your feet to stand up straight.
5. Lower the barbell to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p008.tips:
1. Do not let your knees go over your toes when you squat.
2. To add difficulty, add weights gradually.
3. Keep your knees and elbows slightly bent during the exercise.
4. Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p009.setup: Sit on the bench with feet together on the floor. Hold a barbell and rest it on your thighs.
p009.howto:
1. Exhale and slowly raise your heels up as high as possible.
2. Inhale, lower heels to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p009.tips:
1. Keep your head, spine and neck in line and body balanced during the exercise.
2. Keep pressing the barbell against your knees during the exercise.

p010.setup: Sit on a bench with feet on the floor. Hold the barbell in front of your shoulders with hands slightly wider than shoulder width apart and palms facing forward.
p010.howto:
1.  Exhale and squeeze your shoulders to lift the bar vertically until your arms are straight overhead.
2. Pause for a few seconds, inhale, return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p010.tips:
1. Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2. Do not rest the barbell on your shoulders.
3. Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p011.setup: Squat down in front of the bar with your feet wider than shoulder width apart and hold it with a narrow overhand grip.
p011.howto:
1. Lift the bar as extending your arms to the height above your knees.
2. Retract your shoulder blades, lift your chest up and flex your elbows to bring the bar to the height of your chin.
3.  Return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p011.tips:
1. To add difficulty, add weights gradually.
2. Keep your hips and shoulders rising at the same rate.
3. Keep your knees and elbows slightly bent during the exercise.
4. Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

deadlift.setup: Squat down in front of the barbell with your feet shoulder width apart. Hold it in an overhand grip wider than the shoulder width and arms extended.
deadlift.howto:
1. Squeeze your glutes and tighten your lats.
2. Exhale and lift the barbell until standing up straight.
Rotate your shoulders back until feeling slightly stretched.
3.  Pause for a few seconds, inhale and return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
deadlift.tips:
1.Position your hips between the level of shoulders and knees at the starting position.
2. Move the bar vertically.
3. Brace the abs to support your straight back throughout the movement.
4. Do not pull upward using your arms or shoulders.
5. Do not thrust your hips forward at the top position.

p013.setup: Lie on a bench with feet on the floor. Hold a bar in an overhand grip with arms bent and elbows lifted.
p013.howto:
1. Exhale and extend your elbows to press your hands up until your arms are straight.
2. Pause for a few seconds, inhale, return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p013.tips:
1. Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2. Keep your upper arms still during the exercise.
3. Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p014.setup: Take a wide stance with toes pointed outward. Hold the barbell on the back of your shoulders with hands slightly wider than shoulder width and palms facing forward.
p014.howto:
1. Inhale and squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Hold for a few seconds to feel the contraction.
Exhale, drive through the heels and midfoot to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p014.tips:
1. Keep the tiptoes in the same direction as your knees.
2. ﻿﻿Do not let your knees go over your toes.
3. ﻿﻿Do not lock out your knees at the top.
4. ﻿﻿Keep your glutes, quadriceps and hamstrings engaged.

2. Once the barbell passes your mid-thigh, jump slightly and drop your body under the bar with your elbows facing forward and palms facing up.

4. ﻿﻿Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p016.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Hold the barbell with hands slightly wider than shoulder width apart in an overhand grip and arms extended.
p016.howto:
1.Shrug your shoulders to lift the barbell with your arms straight.
2. Once the bar passes your mid-thigh, jump slightly and drop your body under the bar while lifting the barbell overhead with palms facing forward.

p017.setup: Lie on a bench with feet secured under the footpads. Hold the barbell above your chest with elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward.
p017.howto:
1.  Exhale and squeeze your chest to push the bar up to extend your arms straight.
2.  Inhale and slowly lower your bar to the starting position and repeat.
p017.tips:
1. ﻿﻿Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2. ﻿﻿Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p019.setup: Lie on a bench with feet on the floor. Hold a barbell using an shoulder width overhand grip and press it over your chest with arms stretched.
p019.howto:
1. ﻿﻿Inhale to lower your arms in an arc behind your head until your arms are in line with your torso.
2. ﻿﻿Stretch out your chest and pause for a few seconds.
3. ﻿﻿Exhale to pull the barbell in arc over your head until your arms are vertical to your body.
4. ﻿﻿Repeat slowly.
p019.tips:
1. Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2. Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

2. ﻿﻿Stretch out your chest and pause for a few seconds.

4. ﻿﻿Repeat slowly.
p020.tips:

p021.setup:
Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on the thighs with the wrists ahead of the knees.
Hold the barbell in both hands with an underhand grip.
p021.howto:
1. ﻿﻿Exhale and curl your wrists up.
2. ﻿﻿Pause for a few seconds at the top position.
3. ﻿﻿Inhale and return to the starting position and repeat.
p021.tips:
1. Keep your thighs and forearms parallel to the floor.
2. Keep your elbows and wrists at the same height during the exercise.

p022.setup: Stand and hold the barbell on your shoulders with palms facing forward. Place the toes and the balls of your feet shoulder width apart onto a platform.
p022.howto:
1. ﻿﻿Elevate your heels slowly as high as possible.
2. ﻿﻿Pause at the top for a few seconds, return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p022.tips:
1. ﻿﻿Keep your head, spine and neck in line.
2. ﻿﻿Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p023.setup:
Lie with knees bent and heels on the bench.
Hold a bar in a wide overhand grip and place it over the crease of your hips.
p023.howto:
1. ﻿﻿Press your heels to lift hips up until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
2. ﻿﻿Hold for a few seconds at the top position.
3. ﻿﻿Lower back to the starting position and repeat.
p023.tips:
1. Do not allow your knees fall inward or outward.
2. Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p025.setup: Sit with your upper back against the bench and feet flat on the floor. Lift your hips slightly off the floor and hold the barbell in an overhand grip on the crease of your hips.

Slowly lower the bar to the starting position and repeat.

2. ﻿﻿Do not contact your glutes with the floor during the exercise.

p162.howto:
1.Press your heels to lift hips up until your body forms a straight line
from your shoulders to your knees.
2.Hold fora few seconds at the top position.
3.Lower back to the starting position and repeat.
p162.tips:
1.Do not allow your knees fall inward or outward.
2.Squeeze your glutes when lifting your hips.
3.Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p163.setup:
Bend at your waist and knees with feet shoulder width apart and torso
hearly horizontal. Hold the dumbbell with both hands between your legs.
p163.howto:
1.Contract your glutes and thrust your hips forward to swing the
dumbbell up to your chest level.
2.Swing the dumbbell back down to the starting position and repeat.
p163.tips:

your arms or back.

p164.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand in a neutral grip at your sides with arms straight down.
p164.howto:
1.Inhale and squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.

2.Do not let your knees go over your toes.
3.Do not lock out your knees at the top.
4.Keep your glutes, quadriceps and hamstrings engaged.
5.Make a vertical movement with the dumbbells, do not tilt the arms.

p165.setup: Lie on a bench with feet on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms up and extend your arms to the sides.
p165.howto:
1.Exhale and pull the dumbbells up in an arc motion in front of your
chest.
2.Squeeze your chest and hold for a few seconds.
3.Inhale, return to the starting position and repeat.
p165.tips:
1.Do not Use your biceps at the top position.
2.Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout the movement.

p166.setup: Lie your upper back on a bench with your legs bent and feet planted on the floor. Hold the dumbbell using both hands and press it over your chest with arms stretched.

1.Inhale to lower your arms behind your head until your arms are in line with your torso.

2.Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p167.setup: Lie prone on the bench with toes planted on the ffoor. Holda dumbbell in each hand in an overhand grip with arms hang straight down at your sides.

p168.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Bend over to hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing each other and arms extended downward.

p169.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward.

p170.setup: Lie on a bench with feet on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward on each side of your chest.

p173.setup: Lie on a bench with legs split apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip. Have your arms fully extended next to your thighs and parallel to the floor.

p178.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Bend at hips and hold dumbbells off the floor outside of your thighs with an overhand grip. Slightly bend your knees.

2 Keep the upward movement controlled to avoid pulling yourself out of position.
3 To add difficulty, add weights gradually.

p392.setup: Stand a step away facing the machine with feet shoulder width apart. Hold the bar with both hands in a close overhand grip. Extend your arms upward.
p392.howto:
1 Contract your lats to pull the handle down to the middle of your thighs.
2
Pause for a few seconds and return to the starting position and repeat.
p392.tips:
1
Slightly bend your hips and knees and stand as far as you can from the machine at the start.
2 Do not bend your elbows while pulling the handle down.
3 Keep a braced core during the exercise.

p393.setup: Sit on the machine with your knees secured under the pads. Hold the bar in a close overhand grip and arms stretched upward.

1 Contract your lats and bend your elbows to pull the bar down to your chest.
2 Pause for a few seconds and return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p393.tips:
1 Lean slightly backward and do not arch your back during the movement.
2 Keep the upward movement controlled to avoid pulling yourself out of position.
3 To add difficulty, add weights gradually.

p394.setup: Attach the rope of the machine around your ankle. Stand sideways to the machine and hold it to stabilize.

1 Move your working leg toward and across the standing leg.
2 Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
3
Switch to the other side and repeat the same repetitions.

Do not use momentum to lift or swing your leg.
Keep your upper body straight and stationary during the exercise.
Keep your hips and shoulders squared front.

p395.setup: Attach the rope of the machine around your ankle. Stand sideways to the machine and hold it to stabilize.
p395.howto:
1 Move your working leg toward and across the standing leg.
2 Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
3
Switch to the other side and repeat the same repetitions.
p395.tips:
Do not use momentum to lift or swing your leg.
Keep your upper body straight and stationary during the exercise.
Keep your hips and shoulders squared front.

p396.setup: Stand before the machine with feet shoulder width apart. Stretch your arms forward and hold the handles with an overhand grip.
p396.howto:
Bend the elbows and pull the handles towards your face until your hands are beside your ears.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
p396.tips:
1 To add difficulty, add weights gradually.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p397.setup: Stand back to the machine with feet shoulder width apart. Hold the bar in an overhand grip in front of your thighs.
p397.howto:
Exhale and lift the bar forward to the height of your shoulders.
2 Pause for a few seconds, inhale and return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p397.tips:
1 Keep your arms straight and elbows slightly bent during the exercise.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p398.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Hold the bar at shoulder height with arms bent at your sides.
p398.howto:
nhale and squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
2 Hold for a few seconds to feel the contraction.3
Exhale, drive through the heels and midfoot to the starting position slowly and repeat
p398.tips:
Keep the tiptoes in the same direction as your knees.
2 Do not let your knees go over your toes.
3 Do not lock out your knees at the top.
4 Keep your glutes, quadriceps and hamstrings engaged.

pushdown.setup: Stand with feet hip width apart. Hold the bar over the chest with palms facing forward and elbows bent against your body.
pushdown.howto:
1 Exhale and pull the bar down towards your thighs until your arms are fully extended.
2 Pause for a few seconds, inhale and return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
pushdown.tips:
1 Keep your upper arms steady by your sides.
2 Lean slightly forward and keep your knees slightly bent throughout the movement.
3
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p400.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Hold the machine handle with one hand in an underhand grip and the elbow tucked to your body.
p400.howto:
1 Exhale and extend your elbow to press your hand down until the arm is straight.
2
Pause for a few seconds, inhale, return to the starting position slowly and switch to the other side and repeat the same repetitions.
p400.tips:
1 Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2 Keep your working elbow still and close to your side throughout the movement.
3
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p401.setup: Stand before the machine with feet shoulder width apart. Bend at the hips and hold the handle in an underhand with one hand. Bend your arm and tuck the elbow to your torso.
p401.howto:
1 Exhale and extend your elbow to press your hand backwards until your arm is straight.
2
Pause for a few seconds, inhale, return to the starting position slowly and switch to the other side and repeat the same repetitions.
p401.tips:
1 Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2 Keep your elbows still and close to your sides throughout the movement.
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p402.setup: Lie on the machine with your feet planted on the floor. Hold the handles behind your head, using both hands with a neutral grip and arms extended.
p402.howto:
Exhale to pull the handle over your head until your arms are vertical to your body.
2
Inhale to lower your arms in an arc behind your head until your arms are in line with your torso.
3 Stretch out your chest and pause for a few seconds.
4 Repeat slowly.
p402.tips:
Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercis

p403.setup: Lie prone on the bench with toes planted on the floor. Hold the bar at your chest level, with your hands shoulder width apart in an overhand grip and arms extended.
p403.howto:
1 Exhale and squeeze your lats muscle to pull the bar laterally towards your body as close as possible.
2 Hold for a few seconds, inhale, return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p403.tips:
1Keep your head in line with your body.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p404.setup: Lie on a bench with feet on the floor. Hold a handle in each hand at the height of the chest with elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward.
p404.howto:
1 Exhale and squeeze your chest to press the handles up to extend your arms straight.
Inhale and slowly lower your bar to the starting position and repeat.
p404.tips:
1 Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2 Do not open your arms too far when lowering.
3
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p405.setup: Lie on a bench with feet on the floor. Hold the handles with palms up and extend your arms to the sides.
p405.howto:
1 Exhale and pull the handles up in an arc motion in front of your chest.
2
Squeeze your chest and hold for a few seconds.
3
Inhale, return to the starting position and repeat.
p405.tips:
1 Do not use your biceps at the top position.
2 Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout the movement.
3 Keep a straight back during the exercise.

p406.setup: Stand back to the machine with feet shoulder width apart. Hold the handles at your sides with your elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward.
p406.howto:
1 Exhale and squeeze your shoulders to lift the handles vertically until your arms are straight overhead.
2
Pause for a few seconds, inhale, return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p406.tips:
1 Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2 Keep your knees slightly bent throughout the movement.
3 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p407.setup: Squat down with your back to the low pulley and feet shoulder width apart. Hold the rope attachment between your knees with arms extended.
p407.howto:
1
Squeeze your glutes. Pull the rope through your legs and drive your torso upward until standing up straight.
2 Return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p407.tips:
1 Position your hips between the level of shoulders and knees at the starting position.
2 Brace the abs to support your straight back throughout the movement.
3 Do not pull upward using your arms or shoulders.
4 Do not thrust your hips forward at the top position.

p408.setup: Stand before the machine with feet shoulder width apart. Hold the bar in front of your thighs with palms facing backward and arms extended.
p408.howto:
1 Exhale and and shrug your shoulders as high as possible with straight arms.
2 Hold for a few seconds at the top position.
3 Lower the bar to the starting position and repeat.
p408.tips:
1 Place your hands closer or wider to better exercise different muscles.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p409.setup: Attach the rope of the machine around your ankle. Stand sideways to the machine and hold it to stabilize.
p409.howto:
1 Lift your working leg straight out to the side as far as possible.
2 Pause for a few seconds at the top position.
3 Lower your working leg to the starting position and repeat.
4 Switch to the other side and repeat the same repetitions.
p409.tips:
1 Do not use momentum to lift or swing your leg.
2 Keep your upper body straight and stationary during the exercise.

p410.setup: Stand before the machine with feet shoulder width apart. Squat down to hold the low handle in an overhand grip.
p410.howto:
1 Stretch your legs and pull your back upwards into an upright position.
2 Squeeze your glutes in the upright position.
3 Push your hips back to lower your body to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p410.tips:
1 Do not fully stretch your legs when pulling back upwards.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p411.setup: Lie on a bench with feet secured under the footpads. Hold a handle in each hand in a neutral grip with elbows bent at 90 degrees on each side of your chest.
p411.howto:
1 Exhale and squeeze your chest to push the handles up to extend your arms straight.
2
Inhale and slowly lower your handles to the
starting position and repeat.
p411.tips:
1 Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise

p412.setup: Lie on the bench under the machine with feet secured under the footpads. Hold the handles with palms up and extend your arms to the sides.
p412.howto:
1 Exhale and pull the handles up in an arc motion in front of your chest.
2
Squeeze your chest and hold for a few seconds.
3
Inhale, return to the starting position and repeat.
p412.tips:
1 Do not use your biceps at the top position.
2 Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout the movement.
3 Keep a straight back during the exercise.

p413.setup: Lie on a bench with feet on the floor. Hold the bar in an overhand grip arms bent and elbows lifted.
p413.howto:
1 Exhale and extend your elbows to press your hands up until your arms are straight.
2 Pause for a few seconds, inhale and return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p413.tips:
1 Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2 Keep your upper arms still during the exercise.
3
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p414.setup: Take a big step forward with one leg and your back to the machine. Twist your torso to the opposite side to hold the handle with arms extended.
p414.howto:
1 Pull the handle diagonally downward across your body to hips height by rotating torso, lowering arms, and bending knees.
2
Pause for a few seconds, return to the starting position and switch to the other side and repeat the same repetitions.
p414.tips:
1 Keep your elbows and knees slightly bent throughout the movement.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p415.setup: Take a big step forward with one leg. Bend slightly at the knees and the hips to hold the machine handle in both hands with arms extended.
p415.howto:
1 Exhale and rotate your torso to one side and pull the band diagonally up across your body.
2 Pause at the top for a few seconds, inhale, return to the starting position slowly and switch to the other side and repeat the same repetitions.
p415.tips:
1 Keep your elbows and knees slightly bent throughout the movement.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p416.setup:
Sit on the machine with feet on the pads.
Lean forward to hold the handle using both hands with arms extended.

Squeeze your lats and pull the handle toward your rib cage with chest upright and back straight.
Hold for a few seconds when your hands almost touch your abs.
Return to the starting position slowly and repeat.

1 Keep your knees slightly bent throughout the movement.
2 To add difficulty, add weights gradually.
3 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p417.setup: Sit on the machine with feet on the pads. Hold the bar in front of you in a wide overhand grip with arms extended.

Squeeze your lats and pull the handles toward your rib cage with chest upright and back straight.
Hold for a few seconds when the handles almost touch your abs.
Return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p417.tips:
1 Keep your knees slightly bent throughout the movement.
2 To add difficulty, add weights gradually.
3 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p418.setup: Stand before the machine with feet shoulder width apart. Hold the bar in an overhand grip at shoulder width in front of your hips with arms extended.
p418.howto:
Raise your elbows up and out to the sides until the bar is at your chin level.
2 Contract your shoulders and hold for a few seconds.
3 Lower the bar to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p418.tips:
1 Keep your hands moving vertically.
2 Keep your elbows higher than your forearms during the exercise.
3 Keep the bar close to your body.
4 Keep a straight back during the exercise.

p419.setup: Stand with one foot in front of the other. Hold the handles with palms facing forward and extend
p419.howto:
1 Pull your hands up in front of your body in an arc motion until your hands meet above your head.
2
Squeeze your chest and hold for a few seconds.
3
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
p419.tips:
1 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
2 Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout the movement.

p420.setup: 仰臥屈膝；一手胸口、一手腹部；肩頸放鬆
p420.howto: 鼻吸：腹部溫和隆起、腰背有撐開感；口吐：腹部回落，吐氣略長於吸氣
p420.tips: 胸口少動、肩不聳；吐氣慢長、不憋氣

p421.setup: 仰臥（可墊薄毛巾）；眼看天花板
p421.howto: 下巴水平往後滑做「雙下巴」，後腦勺延伸；維持 3–5 秒
p421.tips: 下巴往後不點頭；力度輕、呼吸不中斷

p422.setup: 四足跪：手在肩下、膝在髖下
p422.howto: 吐氣拱背（貓）；吸氣胸口打開、背下沉（牛）；動作連貫
p422.tips: 用呼吸帶動；肩不聳、腰以舒適角度

p423.setup: 側躺髖膝約 90°；膝可夾枕固定
p423.howto: 固定下半身，上方手像翻書打開，胸口旋轉、視線跟手；回程控制
p423.tips: 膝蓋固定；用胸口帶動，不甩手；吐氣打開更順

p424.setup: 跪姿前臂撐地；腹部輕收、下巴微收
p424.howto: 吐氣胸口往地沉、上背延伸；吸氣回起始；骨盆不前移
p424.tips: 胸口往地沉、不是屁股往後坐；腰不夾痛

p425.setup: 四足跪；手掌均勻受力；手肘打直不鎖死
p425.howto: 吸氣肩胛後收背微下沉；吐氣肩胛前推把地推遠；軀幹穩定
p425.tips: 手肘不彎、只動肩胛；不要聳肩；腹部微收防塌腰

p426.setup: 背靠牆、腳離牆 10–20cm；下背輕貼牆；手肘 90° 前臂貼牆
p426.howto: 先吐氣收肋骨＋腹部輕收；手臂沿牆上滑到可控高度再回
p426.tips: 下背不拱、肋骨不翹；肩不聳、脖子放鬆

p427.setup: 俯臥額頭墊毛巾；腹部輕收
p427.howto: 拇指朝上（上臂外旋），肩胛下沉；Y（約120°）/T（90°）小幅抬起停 1–2 秒再放
p427.tips: 小幅度以控制為主；先伸長再抬；腰不拱、肩離耳

p428.setup: 牆面較易、桌緣較難；身體一條線；腹部輕收
p428.howto: 下放吸氣、肘約 30–45°；推起吐氣回頂端；頂端再把牆/桌推遠 1 秒（肩胛前推）
p428.tips: 身體像板；吐氣推起、頂端再推遠；肩不聳、頸放鬆

p429.setup: 仰臥屈膝；一手下肋、一手腹部
p429.howto: 吸氣下肋向外擴；吐氣下肋往內下合回、腹部輕收，腰中立
p429.tips: 先吐氣收肋骨再吸；腰不拱、肩頸放鬆

p430.setup: 仰臥屈膝（亦可坐/站）；摸骨盆前側作定位
p430.howto: 吐氣後傾讓下背貼近；吸氣前傾讓腰出自然弧度；在兩端之間找最省力中立位
p430.tips: 用骨盆滾動不抬臀；中立＝介於貼平與拱起之間

p431.setup: 坐姿前後腳膝皆約 90°；坐骨平均著地
p431.howto: 吐氣把雙膝翻到另一側換腳；以髖旋轉為主、腰不大扭；換邊停 1–2 秒
p431.tips: 先坐直再換邊；骨盆少歪；需要可用手撐地輔助

p432.setup: 半跪姿；先收肋骨＋腹部輕收、臀部輕夾
p432.howto: 維持骨盆中立下整體微前移，感受後側髖前拉伸；可加同側手上舉/側彎
p432.tips: 維持骨盆中立下整體微前移，感受後側髖前拉伸；可加同側手上舉/側彎

p433.setup: 仰臥桌面腿 90/90；先吐氣收肋骨、腰穩
p433.howto: 吐氣伸對側手＋腳到可控距離；骨盆不晃、肋骨不外翻；吸氣回來交替
p433.tips: 腰穩定優先；伸到控制得住即可；慢、穩、呼吸不中斷

p434.setup: 站姿膝微彎；可用棍三點貼（後腦/上背/尾椎）
p434.howto: 骨盆往後送、軀幹前傾但脊椎中立；膝只微彎；吐氣用臀帶回站直
p434.tips: 屁股往後不是往下蹲；肋骨收住不拱腰；重量在腳中後段

p435.setup: 赤腳坐/站；腳掌三點貼地；腳趾放鬆
p435.howto: 在腳趾不抓地前提下讓前腳掌「往後收」，足弓微抬；維持 3–5 秒
p435.tips: 腳趾放鬆；力道小、抽筋代表太用力；三點著地不塌弓

p436.setup: 赤腳坐/站；三點貼地；膝對第二趾
p436.howto: A 大趾抬：四趾貼地不翹；B 四趾抬：大趾球貼地不抬；各停 2–3 秒交替
p436.tips: 不靠甩、動作慢；三點不離地；抽筋就縮小幅度

p437.setup: 弓箭步或面牆；腳尖朝前；可設目標距離
p437.howto: 膝沿第二趾方向前推靠近目標，足弓穩、腳跟不離地；停 1 秒回來
p437.tips: 膝不內夾；腳跟黏地；終點停 1 秒、控制回程

p438.setup: 站姿扶牆；膝微彎 20–30°；三點著地
p438.howto: 膝角度固定，腳跟抬到最高停 1 秒，慢慢下降
p438.tips: 膝角度固定；下降慢、不重摔；踝維持正中

p439.setup: 背靠牆；腳跟離牆 20–40cm；腳跟固定貼地
p439.howto: 以前腳掌往上抬到最高停 1 秒，控制放下
p439.tips: 腳跟不移位；抬前腳掌非整腳滑動；放下要控制

p440.setup: 背貼牆；雙腳離牆 30–60cm；腳尖朝前
p440.howto: 下滑到半蹲角度（約 45–60°或無痛範圍），膝對第二趾；腹部輕收、骨盆中立
p440.tips: 膝不內夾；腳跟不抬；腰不拱、肋骨收住

p441.setup: 穩固椅；坐椅前 1/3；腳與髖同寬
p441.howto: 髖鉸鏈前傾移重心至腳中段；吐氣站起；吸氣控制坐下輕碰再起
p441.tips: 先前傾再站；膝對第二趾；坐下要慢、不摔坐

p442.setup: Secure a band around a bench and lie on it with feet on the floor. Hold the handles at the height of the chest with elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward.
p442.howto:
1 Exhale and squeeze your chest to push the handles up to extend your arms straight.
2
Inhale and slowly lower your handles to the starting position and repeat.
p442.tips:
1 Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
2 Secure the band where your head rests.
3 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p443.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Attach the band to a sturdy object and bend forward at your waist to hold both ends of the band with arms extended.
p443.howto:
1 Extend your waist to stand up straight.
2 Lower your upper body to the preparation position and repeat.
p443.tips:
1 Do not jerk or bounce.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p444.setup: Stand on the middle of the band with feet together and hold a handle of the band in each hand with a neutral grip next to your thighs.
p444.howto:
Exhale and squeeze your shoulders to raise your arms to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.2
Pause for a few seconds, inhale and return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p444.tips:
1 Do not shrug your shoulders when raising arms up.
2 Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout the movement.
3 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p445.setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Hold a handle in each hand in front of your thighs with palms facing each other. Extend arms tucked to your sides.
p445.howto:
1 Squeeze your biceps to bend your elbows and curl the band up to the height of your chest.
2 Return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p445.tips:
1 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
2 Keep your elbows still to your sides throughout the movement.

p446.setup: Attach the bands to your feet. Lie on the floor with your hands behind your head, elbows wide and legs extended in front.
p446.howto:
Squeeze your abs and rotate your upper body to bring one knee to the opposite elbow while fully extending the opposite leg.
2 Return to the starting position slowly and complete alternating between left and right.
p446.tips:
1 Keep your head in a natural position and do not strain or pull on your neck.
2 Lift your shoulder blades slightly off the floor.
3 Keep a braced core during the exercise.

p447.setup: Attach the band low and stand back to it with feet shoulder width apart. Bend at your waist to hold the handles between your knees with arms extended.
p447.howto:
Squeeze your glutes and tighten your lats.
Pull the band through your legs and drive your torso upward until standing up straight.
Return to the starting position slowly and repeat.
p447.tips:
Position your hips between the level of shoulders and knees at the starting position.
2 Brace the abs to support your straight back throughout the movement.
3 Do not pull upward using your arms or shoulders.
4 Do not thrust your hips forward at the top position.

p448.setup: Stand with one foot forward and place the band under the midfoot. Hold a handle in each hand in an underhand grip with elbows tucked to your sides.
p448.howto:
1 Curl the band up until your forearms touch your chest.
2 Pause for a few seconds and squeeze your biceps.
3 Lower the band to the starting position and repeat.
p448.tips:
1 Keep your chest up and eyes looking forward throughout the movement.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.

p449.setup:
Lie prone on the floor with feet together.
Place a band behind your back and under your hands. Extend your arms with palms slightly wider than shoulder width apart.
p449.howto:
1 Inhale and bend the elbows to lower your body down until your chest almost touches the floor.
2
Exhale and raise your body back to the starting position and repeat.
p449.tips:
1 Do not fully extend your arms.
2 Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
3 Do not let your chest touch the floor.

p450.setup: Place an object under your belly to elevate your lower body and lie face down. Attach the band around your ankles and straighten your legs together.
p450.howto:
1 Squeeze your hamstrings to curl your legs up and raise your heels toward your hips, keeping your thighs and hips on the object.
2 Hold for a few seconds at the top position.
3 Return to the starting position and repeat.
p450.tips: 1 Do not lock out your knees at the bottom.

p451.setup: Place the band under one midfoot. Begin on all fours with knees hip-width apart and hands holding the handles under your shoulders.
p451.howto:
Stretch and kick one leg back until your thigh is parallel with the floor.
2
Squeeze your glutes and hold for a few seconds at the top position.

Return to the starting position and repeat.
